headline: Staking ramp lifts revenue as losses narrow sharply
summary_short: Revenue reached $46.5M, up 321% q/q and roughly 22x y/y, as newly launched ETH staking operations ramped; net loss narrowed to $83.6M from a $3.8B prior-quarter loss that had been driven by a one-off unrealized ETH markdown.
summary_long: Revenue reached $46.5M (+321% q/q), driven by native ETH staking launched in November 2025 and expanded via the Pier Two acquisition — staking and validation revenue alone was $45.7M versus zero a year earlier. Gross profit rose to $40.8M. Operating loss narrowed to $11.9M as the prior quarter's outsized unrealized ETH markdown did not recur, but a $92.1M net loss on expired/exercised derivative option contracts pushed net loss to $83.6M (diluted EPS -$0.15), partly offset by a $16.5M warrant fair-value gain and $5.3M interest income. Total cash was $446M as of May 31, 2026. Management guides ETH custodian/management fees of $40-50M annually against $1.5M capex and $33.3M in Series A Preferred dividend obligations over the next 12 months.
